O-FEE:sign-loss.rationale: User wants legacy unsigned behaviour: negative FEE silently drops its sign.

O-FEE:sign-loss+truncation.rationale: User wants legacy behaviour: FEE drops sign and truncates high-order digits on overflow.

O-INT:high-order-truncation.rationale: User wants legacy behaviour: INTEREST silently truncates high-order digits on overflow.

O-FEE:rounding.rationale: User wants legacy intermediate-precision truncation reproduced exactly for FEE.

O-NEW:sign-loss.rationale: User accepts modern behaviour: negative NEW-BAL prints with its sign rather than silently becoming positive.

O-NEW:sign-loss+truncation.rationale: User accepts modern behaviour: NEW-BAL shows sign and full value rather than silently truncating and dropping sign.

O-NEW:high-order-truncation.rationale: User accepts modern behaviour: NEW-BAL shows the full value rather than silently truncating high-order digits.

BALANCE:input-overflow.rationale: User accepts modern behaviour: full BALANCE value is used rather than silently truncating on input.

RATE:input-overflow.rationale: User accepts modern behaviour: full RATE value is used rather than silently truncating on input.

DAYS:input-overflow.rationale: User accepts modern behaviour: full DAYS value is used rather than silently truncating on input.

RATE:input-sign-loss.rationale: User accepts modern behaviour: negative RATE is used as-is rather than silently becoming positive.

DAYS:input-sign-loss.rationale: User accepts modern behaviour: negative DAYS is used as-is rather than silently becoming positive.
